subject: Executive review requested — Aurora service deficits & commercial make-right plan
messages:
From: Sierra Lopez <sierra@aurora.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marco Diaz <marco.diaz@aurora.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Production degradation — sustained latency and 5xxs for /predict, request for commercial remediation

Karthik / Lauren,

We're still seeing sustained tail latency and intermittent 5xx errors hitting our /predict route since last Friday. This is materially affecting our customer demos (we've had two canceled POCs this week) and impacting our production SLAs. I've attached a short timeline and a couple of payload captures.

We need:
- A clear root cause summary and timeline (what happened, when recovery started, what mitigations were applied).
- A proposed commercial remediation (credit or refund) and how you plan to document it in the contract.
- Exec-level touchpoint today if possible — our CRO is asking for a call.

Please let me know availability for a 30–45 minute exec call this afternoon.

Regards,
Sierra Lopez
Head of Platform Ops, Aurora Data Systems
Attachments: incident_timeline.pdf, sample_payloads.zip
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Sierra Lopez <sierra@aurora.ai>, Marco Diaz <marco.diaz@aurora.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Production degradation — sustained latency and 5xxs for /predict, request for commercial remediation

Sierra — thanks for the clear summary and the attachments. I'm very sorry for the impact you're seeing. We're treating this as a top-priority escalation.

Immediate steps we've already taken:
- Scoped the incident window: 2026-11-27 02:13 UTC -> 2026-11-30 22:50 UTC.
- Rolled back a kernel-level change to the serving runtime at 2026-11-30 17:40 UTC.
- Enabled an emergency routing policy to a compatible model variant at 18:10 UTC to stabilize throughput (latency improved ~40% after).

We will produce a concise post-incident root cause memo by EOD tomorrow. For commercial remediation, I would like to propose a starting point and then iterate with your legal/finance teams: a credit equal to the measured token-hour shortfall converted at your committed rate plus a discretionary goodwill credit to account for demo impacts. I'll attach a worked example.

Can we schedule an exec call at 3:30pm PT today (30 minutes)? I'm looping in Lauren (CS lead) and Vanessa (sales ops) to coordinate the contract and billing threads.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
Attachments: (none in this message)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: FW: Production degradation — proposed credit calc for Aurora (internal)

Team — forwarding Aurora's escalation. Quick summary and asks:

Summary: Aurora experienced sustained tail latency and a spike in 5xxs across a high-throughput route across the weekend. We've applied mitigations and stabilized service. They are requesting a commercial remediation and want contract language for a documented make-right.

Asks:
1) Finance: please review the proposed credit calc attached (proposed_credit_calc.xlsx) and confirm what we can offer from a precedent and margin perspective. I'm proposing: measured shortfall credit + $40k discretionary goodwill for the sales motion.
2) Legal: need a short contract amendment (one-paragraph) that documents: incident window, credit applied, and that both parties agree this resolves the SLA claim for the period. We should keep it narrow — no change to broader T&Cs.
3) CS/Ops (Lauren/Connor): finalize the incident timeline and root cause memo. We should have a customer-facing RCA by tomorrow EOD.

I'll be on the exec call at 3:30pm PT to align with Aurora's leadership. Please flag any concerns on the quick credit number above.

Thanks,
Karthik
From: Aurora Legal <legal@aurora.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sierra Lopez <sierra@aurora.ai>, Marco Diaz <marco.diaz@aurora.ai>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 08:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Production degradation — sustained latency and 5xxs for /predict, request for commercial remediation

Vanessa / Karthik,

Thanks for the quick response and the proposed approach on credits. For the formal amendment we need:
- A worked credit schedule with explicit calculations and the base contract reference (Section 4.2 in our signed MSA).
- A one-paragraph amendment statement that the credit fully resolves the parties' SLA claims for the defined incident window.
- DocuSign-ready language; please provide a draft so we can route internally today.

Our legal team would also like to see the telemetry slices used to compute the shortfall (token counts, average token latency, and error rates by hour) and the incident timeline. If you plan to include a discretionary goodwill credit, please annotate the ledger entry so auditors can trace the approval chain.

We are available on the 3:30pm PT call; our CFO will join for the credit discussion.

Regards,
Aurora Legal
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Sierra Lopez <sierra@aurora.ai>, Aurora Legal <legal@aurora.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 04 Dec 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Executive review requested — Aurora service deficits & commercial make-right plan

Sierra / Marco / Aurora team — thank you for the call earlier and for the constructive conversation. Summary and next steps below: 

Summary of agreed commercial remediation:
- Incident window: 2026-11-27 02:13 UTC -> 2026-11-30 22:50 UTC.
- Measured shortfall credit: $92,400 (worked calculation in attached proposed_credit_calc.xlsx; includes token-hour shortfall at committed rate).
- Discretionary goodwill credit: $40,000.
- Total credit to be applied: $132,400.

Contract amendment and execution:
- We will prepare a one-paragraph amendment that references the incident window and the credit applied and confirms mutual release for that incident period. Draft will be uploaded to DocuSign and shared with Aurora Legal by EOD today (link: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/aurora-contract-amend).

Operational follow-ups:
- Customer-facing RCA: CS/Ops will publish a concise RCA tomorrow EOD and include remediation actions to avoid recurrence.
- Finance: please prepare billing ledger entry and expected refund timeline (Naomi, Connor — can you validate the refund date and accounting code?).

Thanks again for the candid discussion. We appreciate Aurora's partnership and will follow through on the DocuSign draft and the RCA deliverable.

—Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
Attachments: proposed_credit_calc.xlsx, exec-call-agenda.md
